To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

temporal aggregation of local features can be used to improve the performance of the image to video search task and that deep learning representations can be used to perform temporal aggregation of visual information.
temporal aggregation of local features is a powerful tool to perform large scale image to video retrieval.

(i) the aggregation of temporal features is a powerful tool to reduce the amount data that need to be processed in image to video retrieval tasks, (ii) the temporal aggregation of deep features outperforms the aggregation of local features and (iii) the temporal aggregation is more effective for videos with higher frame rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with

three main contributions: (i) the development of a new temporal aggregation technique for image to video retrieval; (ii) an extensive evaluation of the performance of several temporal aggregation techniques in image to video retrieval and (iii) a comparative study of the impact of different local features and deep representations for temporal aggregation in image to video tasks.

three main aspects: (i) how to aggregate visual information from video data; (ii) how to efficiently retrieve the best matching frame in the database, given a static image as query; and (iii) how to efficiently search for the best matching frame given a video as query.

three different aspects: (1) how to aggregate visual temporal features from video data, (2) how to exploit these temporal features in the image to video search task and (3) how to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of deep learning representations for temporal feature aggregation is the most effective approach, and that it is possible to obtain good results even with a simple temporal aggregation strategy.
the proposed aggregation techniques can be successfully used to reduce the dimension of the feature vector while retaining the information needed to perform retrieval tasks.

the use of temporal aggregation techniques for large scale image to video retrieval is a promising approach that can be used to reduce the complexity of the retrieval process, but that it is still necessary to explore new techniques to improve the quality and performance of the retrieval process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have explored the use of temporal aggregation techniques in the context of image to video matching.
the temporal information is a valuable source of information for video retrieval and it can be used to reduce the amount and dimensionality of data that is needed to perform the retrieval task.
we propose a new temporal aggregation method based on the use of a deep learning architecture, which is able to extract a more robust representation of the temporal structure from video data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
temporal aggregation techniques can be applied to both local and deep representations and that they are complementary to the use of temporal information in video representations.
temporal aggregation techniques are able to improve the performance of image to video matching by exploiting the redundancy within the video data.
, for the task of image to search video, the temporal aggregation of features can be performed in a simple and efficient way, without requiring the use of temporal models.
